Q: Interpreting correlation result obtained from R studio A:

The corrplot package for R has tools that given a correlation matrix will produce a plot (with lots of options controlling how the plot will look) that gives a visual graph representing the correlations and helping to visualize and compare them. I do not know of any audio representations of correlations.

Also note that R is the program that does the calculations, RStudio is a Graphical User Interface that helps with interactions between the user and the R program.
